Senior Landscape Architect

Help shape the future of landscape at Hawkins\Brown

At Hawkins\Brown, we create places that bring lasting value to people, communities and cities. From delivering the award-winning Thames Pocket Parks programme for Tideway to contributing to the transformation and pedestrianisation of Oxford Street, our work demonstrates the power of thoughtful landscape and public realm design.

Having worked alongside some of the UK's leading landscape architecture practices for many years, we're now investing in the growth of our own in-house landscape team. This is an exciting opportunity to join us at a formative stage and play a key role in shaping the future direction of landscape architecture within the practice.

We're looking for an experienced Senior Landscape Architect who combines design excellence with technical expertise and a passion for project delivery. You will lead the detailed design, coordination and implementation of landscape packages across a diverse portfolio of projects, working collaboratively with architects, urban designers, engineers, sustainability specialists and clients.

What you'll be doing

Leading the detailed design and technical development of landscape packages from RIBA Stage 4 through to completion.
Producing high-quality, coordinated landscape information that is robust, buildable and deliverable.
Managing landscape models and leading BIM coordination within multidisciplinary project teams using Revit.
Coordinating closely with architects, engineers, contractors and specialist consultants to deliver complex projects.
Guiding project delivery, programme management and consultant coordination across multiple workstreams.
Contributing to the development of landscape BIM standards, delivery processes and best practice across the practice.
Helping to shape and grow Hawkins\Brown's landscape capability for the future.

Chartered Member of the Landscape Institute (CMLI), or equivalent experience
Significant professional experience delivering landscape projects through detailed design and construction.
Strong technical knowledge of landscape construction, materials, planting and specification writing.
Advanced Revit skills and experience working within BIM-led project environments.
A collaborative approach and confidence leading multidisciplinary teams.
Passion for creating outstanding landscapes, public realm and environmentally responsible places

Why Hawkins\Brown?

You'll join a supportive, multidisciplinary studio environment, working on a diverse range of projects and collaborating with talented colleagues across the practice. As our landscape team grows, you'll have the opportunity to play an important role in its development and future direction.

Great Opportunity at Portus and Whitton Landscape Ltd

We are recruiting for a Graduate Landscape Architect to join our professional team in Cirencester. The broad scope of work that we undertake will provide an excellent opportunity at all levels, to focus on your design skills and gain experience.

The role will involve working within the team on a number of exciting projects at different design stages, from concept to planning, through to tender and contract implementation. You will have the opportunity to learn and progress.

We are keen to hear from proactive, confident and creative individuals with excellent design and communication skills. You will have a proven competency in CAD and strong 3D graphic and visualisation skills. Experience of Vectorworks and Adobe Indesign are advantageous, but not a requirement. Applicants will have a relevant graduate qualification and a desire to further their career.

Portus and Whitton are an established, successful practice who focus on design-led work.

We work on a wide variety of landscape schemes and have considerable experience of historically and architecturally sensitive design projects.

Our work also includes private gardens; care villages; hotel and leisure sites; small scale housing developments; masterplanning major developments; tourism related work in the countryside; Landscape Impact Assessments and Planning Inquiries.

We frequently work as part of multi-disciplinary teams, consulting with public authorities and government agencies. Please view our website for further information on our work. We offer a competitive salary, private pension, healthcare, regular CPD events and flexible working arrangements. Start date to be arranged as soon as possible.

Salary and benefits will be commensurate with skills and experience.

Please email through a full CV, portfolio of work examples and covering letter to trudy.compton@portusandwhitton.co.uk

Please only apply if you have the right to work in the UK.

Portland Landscape Architect (4-8 Years)

Walker Macy is seeking a landscape architect or landscape designer with 4-8 years of professional experience for our Portland, OR office to assist in the design and technical development of projects. We are looking for candidates with enthusiasm and energy for design, and a willingness to jump in and try new things.

Walker Macy is a design firm that provides landscape architecture, urban design, and planning services throughout the Western United States. We are a Women-Owned Business and Equal Opportunity Employer.

We focus on public projects such as parks, waterfronts, and campuses and our broad range of work includes site design for civic and cultural buildings, interpretive centers, and mixed-use development. We have a collaborative team culture with a commitment to innovative design, sustainability, and client relationships.

This position requires a professional degree in landscape architecture (BLA or MLA), a strong sense of spatial design and experience developing design studies, strong graphic representation abilities, and experience producing design development or construction documents for medium or large-scale projects.

Our ideal candidate will be self-motivated and flexible with strong communication skills, a willingness to take initiative and an interest in working as part of a team. Experience coordinating with other design and engineering consultants as well as professional teammates is essential.

Professional experience working in AutoCAD or Revit, Adobe Creative Suite and 3D modelling is required. Knowledge of LandFx and an interest in planting design is also beneficial.

Resume
Digital Portfolio with work samples including CAD or Revit plans and details along with examples of design or graphic work, and/or built project photography. Please do not mail hard copies of portfolios or letters. Please submit digital copies only in PDF format at 10 MB or less. Please do not send ISSU or Google Drive or other online portal links. Email the applications and portfolio materials to: careers@WalkerMacy.com

Applications will be accepted until September 18th, 2026, and top candidates will be invited for an interview within 3 weeks. Online interviews are available for candidates not currently living in the Portland region.
